company.name: Aspen Dental
company.what_they_do: Aspen Dental is a brand of independently owned dental practices that offer routine and emergency care, dentures, implants and clear aligners. The Aspen Group (TAG) licenses the brand and provides business and administrative support to these practices.
company.customers: Patients across the United States who need routine, emergency, denture, implant or cosmetic dental care. Many offers are aimed at new patients without dental insurance and at denture wearers.
company.how_they_sell: Patients book appointments online by choosing an office and visit type, or by phone. Treatment plans and estimates are given in the office. Payment runs through a billing portal, by phone or by email, with third-party financing and a $49 per year savings plan membership.
company.size_hints: 1100+ offices nationwide, 3000+ dental experts in the network, 10 million smiles served, in business since 1998. The 1,000th office opened in 2022. The support center is in Chicago.

audit.headline: The first thing worth automating at Aspen Dental is the customer service billing inbox, because missing and declined payments are checked there by hand, one central team owns it, and reply times can be measured from week 1.
audit.caveat: Aspen Dental offices are independently owned and supported by The Aspen Group, so the website cannot show which tasks the central support team in Chicago handles and which each office handles in its own way.

signals.observation: Patients cannot cancel online. They have to call their local office, and staff handle each cancellation by hand.
signals.quote: If you need to cancel your appointment, call your  local Aspen Dental  office and let them know. They will assist you with the cancellation process.

signals.observation: Rescheduling also means contacting the office directly, and patients have to look up the office details first.
signals.quote: you can reschedule by contacting your Aspen Dental office to let them know that you need to move your appointment.

signals.observation: Emergency appointments start with a phone call to the local office, not online triage.
signals.quote: For urgent dental issues, call your local Aspen Dental office immediately. We prioritize emergency cases and will make every effort to see you the same day.

signals.observation: When a payment does not show up, the patient sends an email and staff check it by hand.
signals.quote: If your payment hasn't appeared after this timeframe, email  customerservice@aspendental.com  with your payment confirmation details.

signals.observation: Declined payments also go to the customer service inbox for manual checking.
signals.quote: Check with your bank or card provider, then email  customerservice@aspendental.com  to verify or update your payment details.

signals.observation: Billing questions are spread across a phone line, office phones and a shared email inbox.
signals.quote: For any billing or payment questions, call (833) 902-4848 or  email customerservice@aspendental.com .

signals.observation: Requests for records for a second opinion are handled by staff one request at a time.
signals.quote: We'll gladly provide your dental records and X-rays upon request to facilitate your consultation with another provider.

signals.observation: Patients are asked to bring paper records, medications and IDs to the first visit, which suggests intake is done by hand.
signals.quote: please bring your photo identification, any necessary medical records and a list of any current medications.

signals.observation: Denture refunds follow a set process with time windows that staff have to track for each patient.
signals.quote: The guarantee period begins upon insert of final denture or hard reline and refund request must be submitted within 90 days thereafter.

signals.observation: Feedback is collected through a toll-free phone line.
signals.quote: Tell us about your experience by calling toll-free (844) 296-0187.

signals.observation: Each booking widget pushes phone scheduling as an option, so phone booking volume is likely high.
Price estimates are only given during an in-person visit, so each quote takes an appointment.
signals.quote: Schedule a visit today to receive a personalized estimate and explore affordable treatment options designed around your needs.

opportunities.title: Sort billing emails and check payment status automatically
opportunities.problem: Patients whose payment has not shown up, or whose card was declined, email the shared customer service inbox, and staff check each one by hand. Billing questions also come in through a central phone line and office phones, so the same issue can be handled more than once.
opportunities.approach: Sort incoming emails by type (missing payment, declined payment, balance question, other) with inbox rules and a text classifier. For missing payments, pull the confirmation details from the email and look them up in the patient billing portal records, then send a status reply. For declined payments, reply right away with a secure link to update card details in the billing portal and send the rest to staff.

measure.metric: Median time to first reply on billing emails, and share of missing or declined payment emails closed without a manual lookup
measure.baseline: In week 1, pull timestamps from the inbox for all billing emails and hand-tag a sample by type to get current reply time and volume by category
measure.target: Cut median first reply time by at least half from the week 1 figure, and close a clear share of declined-payment emails through the portal link with no staff touch

opportunities.days_30: Baseline reply times and email categories measured, sorting rules live on the inbox.
opportunities.days_60: Auto-replies for declined payments live, missing-payment lookup tested on a sample.
opportunities.days_90: Missing-payment lookup live, reply time and touch-free close rate reported against baseline.
opportunities.assumption: The plan assumes the billing inbox gets enough missing and declined payment emails to matter, and that the billing portal records can be looked up by a tool rather than only by staff logins.
opportunities.ask: How many emails does the customerservice@aspendental.com inbox get in a normal week, and what share are about missing or declined payments?

opportunities.title: Online cancel and reschedule from reminder messages
opportunities.problem: Patients cannot cancel or reschedule online. They have to find their office and call, and office staff handle each change by hand while also fielding phone bookings.
opportunities.approach: Add cancel and reschedule links to appointment confirmations and reminders, connected to the same scheduling system that powers online booking. Freed slots go back into online availability right away, and a short waitlist can offer them to patients who want an earlier visit. Start with a pilot group of offices.

measure.metric: Share of cancellations and reschedules done online in pilot offices, and cancel or reschedule calls per office per week
measure.baseline: In week 1, have pilot offices tag incoming calls by reason for one week, and pull cancellation and reschedule counts from the scheduling system
measure.target: Move a meaningful share of cancellations and reschedules in pilot offices online, with a matching drop in related calls, and track how many freed slots are rebooked

opportunities.days_30: Pilot offices chosen, call reasons tagged, scheduling system links scoped.
opportunities.days_60: Cancel and reschedule links live in reminders for pilot offices.
opportunities.days_90: Online share, call volume and slot refill rate reported, rollout plan for more offices drafted.
opportunities.assumption: The plan assumes the online booking system can also handle cancels and reschedules for existing appointments, and that the independently owned offices will agree to give up phone control of their schedules.
opportunities.ask: Does the system behind online booking already hold every appointment, including ones booked by phone, and could it accept a cancel or reschedule from a link without office staff stepping in?

opportunities.title: Track denture guarantee windows and refund requests
opportunities.problem: Denture refunds depend on a 90-day window that starts at final insert or hard reline, and staff have to track that date for each patient by hand. Missed or late tracking risks wrong decisions on refunds and unhappy patients.
opportunities.approach: Record the insert or reline date as a set field, calculate the window end date automatically, and route refund requests through a simple form that checks eligibility. Send staff a list of open requests and windows closing soon.

measure.metric: Time from refund request to decision, and share of requests with the insert date and window checked automatically
measure.baseline: In week 1, pull recent refund requests and record how long each took to decide and how the window was checked
measure.target: Every new request has its window checked automatically, and time to decision is shorter than the week 1 figure

opportunities.days_30: Current refund process mapped and recent request times measured.
opportunities.days_60: Window date field and request form live for pilot offices.
opportunities.days_90: Decision times reported against baseline, open-request list in weekly use.
opportunities.assumption: The plan assumes staff track the 90-day window by hand and that refund requests are common enough to cause delays, but the website only shows that the policy exists.
opportunities.ask: How many denture refund requests come in each month, and how does staff check today whether a request falls inside the 90-day window?

dropped.title: Digital intake forms before the first visit
dropped.reason: The plan assumes intake is still done on paper, when the website only shows the normal advice to bring ID and a medication list that almost every dental office gives.

questions: How many emails does the customerservice@aspendental.com inbox get in a normal week, and what share are about missing or declined payments?
Does the system behind online booking already hold every appointment, including ones booked by phone, and could it accept a cancel or reschedule from a link without office staff stepping in?
How many denture refund requests come in each month, and how does staff check today whether a request falls inside the 90-day window?
Which systems are shared by all 1,100+ offices, such as scheduling, billing and patient records, and which ones can each office choose for itself?
Who answers the (833) 902-4848 billing line and the customer service inbox, and how many people work on them?
Out of all the calls an office gets, which kind takes the most staff time each week?

pages.title: About Aspen Dental: Our Story, Mission, & Expert Dental Care
pages.text:
Aspen Dental makes healthy smiles available for all
Aspen Dental makes healthy smiles available for all
At Aspen Dental, we’re dedicated to providing more people with the dental care they need, when they need it.
Whether you need routine or emergency care, dentures, implants or clear aligners, we’re here for you when and where you need us.
The Aspen Dental mission statement
Since 1998, Aspen Dental has been dedicated to one mission: ensuring that more Americans can access quality dental care in their communities.
play_arrow
“Aspen Dental was founded in 1998 on a simple belief: That dentistry could be better for patients and providers alike. Together with the dentists we support, we’re committed to breaking down barriers — whether emotional, financial, or practical — so that patients can get the care they need.”
-Bob Fontana, Chairman & CEO, TAG
Aspen Dental history
Key historical milestones
1998:   Aspen Dental was founded in Syracuse, New York.
2000–2004:   Expanded rapidly from New York into Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts, reaching over 60 locations.
2004: Launched the  Practice Ownership Program (POP) , a structured pathway designed to help dentists transition from associates to practice owners.
2014: Initiated the  Healthy Mouth Movement , a community outreach program providing free dental care to U.S. veterans.
2021:  Introduced The Aspen Group (TAG) to reflect growth beyond dental into additional healthcare sectors, including urgent care (WellNow), medical aesthetics (Chapter), and veterinary care (Lovet Pet Health Care).
2022:  Reached a major growth milestone by opening its 1,000th office in Norridge, Illinois.
2023-2026:  Transitioned all offices to fully digital operations and continued geographic expansion.

TAG Oral Care Center for Excellence
Expanding access to care for underserved communities in Illinois
The TAG Oral Care Center for Excellence (OCC) is a first of its kind facility dedicated to providing cutting-edge, comprehensive dental care at no cost to underserved Illinois residents. It also offers TAG team members from across the country hands-on educational and training experiences.

One goal, one network: Independent dentists at The Aspen Group
There is no single provider of dental care called “Aspen Dental.” Each Aspen Dental branded practice is owned and operated by a licensed dentist. The Aspen Group. (“TAG”) provides administrative and business support services to Aspen Dental branded dental practices.
TAG licenses the “Aspen Dental” brand name to the independently owned and operated dental practices that use its business support services. TAG does not own or operate the dental practices, employ or in any way supervise the dentists providing dental care, and control over the care provided is the sole responsibility of the independent practice and the dentists they employ. Services and office practices may vary across dental practices, and patients should contact the dental offices directly for all questions concerning their dental treatment.​
The term “Aspen Dental” issued throughout this website and, depending upon the context, may refer to an individual Aspen Dental branded dental practice or multiple Aspen Dental location dental practices.​
Tell us about your experience by calling toll-free (844) 296-0187.
Aspen Dental practice support
Aspen Dental practices are supported by The Aspen Group (TAG), a healthcare support organization focused on helping providers deliver better care to more people.
Headquartered in Chicago, TAG’s Practice Support Center provides business and administrative services to independently owned and operated Aspen Dental-branded practices across the country. This enables dental teams to stay focused on what matters most -- caring for their patients.
If you are an existing patient with questions or concerns, please contact your local Aspen Dental office for the fastest resolution.

pages.title: Affordable Dental Costs & Flexible Financing Options
pages.text:
Aspen Dental price list for affordable care
Aspen Dental’s price list is designed to help you understand dental costs and plan your care with confidence. Because every smile is different, pricing may vary based on treatment, materials and individual needs. Personalized treatment plans include clear cost breakdowns before care begins, along with access to special offers and flexible payment options.
Denture prices at Aspen Dental
Learn more about denture prices to understand how factors like denture type, materials, and customization can affect the overall cost and help you choose the right option for your needs.
Explore full denture cost Explore partial denture cost
Dental implant prices at Aspen Dental
Learn more about implant prices to understand how factors like the number of implants, materials, and any additional procedures can affect overall cost and help you plan your treatment.
Explore dental implants cost Explore implant dentures cost
Dental services prices
Dental checkup cost >
Regular checkups help prevent costly emergency treatments. At Aspen Dental, we offer affordable care to make getting started easier. Prevention is always more affordable than treatment.
Tooth extraction cost >
If a tooth can’t be saved with a filling or root canal, an extraction may be recommended. Our team reviews all options first and provides comfortable care when removal is necessary.
Dental bridges cost >
Dental bridges replace missing teeth to restore function and appearance. As a fixed solution, they’re custom-made to match your smile and are often partially covered by dental insurance.
Dental crowns cost >
Dental crowns strengthen and restore teeth that can’t be treated with a filling. We use custom crowns designed for durability and a natural appearance.
Dental filling cost >
Tooth decay doesn’t have to lead to costly problems. We offer affordable filling options and work with insurance and financing plans to make treatment accessible.
Periodontal treatment cost >
Gum disease is common but highly treatable when caught early. Periodontal treatment (deep cleaning) removes infection and helps prevent more costly procedures later.
Root canal cost >
Root canal treatment relieves pain and retains your natural teeth. We provide comfortable care with clear pricing and offer insurance and financing options to make treatment more manageable.
Wisdom teeth removal cost >
Wisdom teeth are often removed to prevent crowding, infection, or damage to nearby teeth. We offer simple removal with anesthesia options, and work with you to manage cost.
Cosmetic dentistry pricing
Cosmetic dentistry cost guide >
Explore cosmetic treatments designed to enhance your smile, from whitening to full smile makeovers. Options are available to fit different goals and budgets.
Motto® clear aligners cost >
Motto® clear aligners provide a clear, doctor-guided alternative to traditional braces. Flexible  3rd-party financing options help make treatment manageable.
Teeth whitening cost >
Get noticeably whiter teeth with professional, in-office treatment. Advanced technology and dental supervision help ensure safe, effective results.
Veneers cost >
Porcelain and composite veneers from Aspen Dental offer a simple way to enhance your smile. Designed to cover stains, chips, cracks and gaps, veneers create a more even, natural-looking appearance.

pages.text:
How much do full dentures cost?
Full dentures are a long-term way to restore your smile and confidence. They sit directly on your gums and stay in place with the help of adhesives, so you can eat, speak and smile with ease and confidence.
Key takeaways
Full dentures offer stability and comfort while restoring your smile
We provide clear pricing and offers financing through 3rd-party lenders to help make treatment affordable
Your Aspen Dental care team is with you every step of the way, offering care and guidance you can trust
Dentures start at $499 per arch
with the purchase of an Aspen Dental Savings Plan membership¹
At Aspen Dental, we’re committed to making dentures affordable and accessible for everyone. Our Basic replacement denture starts at just $499 per arch with an Aspen Dental Savings Plan membership¹, providing a budget-friendly option for restoring your smile.
¹The Aspen Dental Savings Plan is NOT insurance, and costs $49/year. Offer available in select offices. Price is for a Basic single arch denture. Additional charges for relines and other required dentistry services, including extractions. Please see plan terms and conditions for details.
More ways to smile for less
We offer replacement full denture solutions designed to fit your smile—and your budget. With transparent pricing and a range of replacement options, we make it simple to restore your smile with confidence.
Custom features available
If you need greater customization, choose from Classic , Signature and Signature Elite dentures—each designed to provide superior comfort, durability and a natural look.
Types of dentures and cost: get the right fit, affordably
Aspen Dental offers a variety of denture options designed to fit your needs and budget, making quality dentures more accessible without compromise. F ull dentures and partial dentures are crafted with care to provide a natural look and comfortable fit, ensuring you find the right solution for your lifestyle.
To give you peace of mind, Aspen Dental backs its dentures with industry-leading warranties and our Denture Money-Back Guarantee ². If you’re not completely satisfied, we’ll make it right—or your money back.

pages.title: Dental Questions and Answers
pages.text:
Frequently asked questions
Have questions about your dental care? You’re in the right place. Get answers from dental experts on everything from services and emergency care to billing and payment options, and if you need additional support, the Aspen Dental Patient Advocacy Team is here to help.
Appointment FAQs
Are you accepting new patients? add_circle_outline
Absolutely, we love welcoming new patients. As a new Aspen Dental patient, your first appointment will include a comprehensive oral exam  and dental X-rays. Your Aspen Dental care team will discuss your personalized treatment plan, pricing options and any other questions you may have.
How do I cancel an Aspen Dental appointment (online or by phone)? add_circle_outline
If you need to cancel your appointment, call your  local Aspen Dental  office and let them know. They will assist you with the cancellation process.
How do I reschedule my appointment at Aspen Dental? add_circle_outline
If you need to reschedule your appointment at Aspen Dental, no worries. If you are a new or existing patient, you can reschedule by contacting your Aspen Dental office to let them know that you need to move your appointment. You can find your office’s information (phone number, hours, etc.) here by searching for your local office.
Also, you can find your office’s details in any previous communications you received from Aspen Dental regarding your appointment.
How quickly can I get an emergency dental appointment? add_circle_outline
For urgent dental issues, call your local Aspen Dental office immediately. We prioritize emergency cases and will make every effort to see you the same day. If you're experiencing severe pain or complications, don't wait—contact us right away. Please dial 9-1-1 if you are experiencing an emergency.
Can I schedule a first appointment just for a preventive cleaning? add_circle_outline
To give you the best dental care possible, your Aspen Dental dentist will first perform an initial exam. With a more clear picture of your current oral health , they’ll create a treatment plan for you and can schedule your appointment for a dental cleaning .
Does Aspen Dental charge for missed appointments (no show fees)? add_circle_outline
No, Aspen Dental does not charge patients for missed appointments (no shows).
I want a second opinion on my recommended treatment plan—is that okay? add_circle_outline
We fully support patients seeking second opinions, whether from another Aspen Dental provider or an outside dentist. We'll gladly provide your dental records and X-rays upon request to facilitate your consultation with another provider.
First visit FAQs
What should I bring to my first dental appointment? add_circle_outline
To prepare for your first Aspen Dental visit, please bring your photo identification, any necessary medical records and a list of any current medications. If you have any previous dental records or X-rays, it’s helpful to bring those as well.
What should I expect during my first dental appointment? add_circle_outline
During your initial dental appointment, you can expect a comprehensive dental examination. This includes X-rays , a thorough exam of your teeth and gums and a discussion about your dental and medical history. Your dentist will evaluate and discuss the best treatment plan for your overall  oral health , addressing any concerns or questions you may have. Please note that preventative teeth cleanings are not included in your first exam.
How long does a typical first dental appointment last? add_circle_outline
The first dental appointment lasts between 45 to 90 minutes on average. However, the duration of your first visit can vary depending on the complexity of your exam, any need for X-rays or additional screening and whether your smile requires any immediate treatment.
Will the dentist discuss treatment options during the first visit? add_circle_outline
Yes, your dentist will go over any recommended treatments based on their evaluation of your oral health. They’ll talk through treatment options that align with your oral health needs and smile goals, answer any questions and work with you to create a personalized care plan for you and your smile.
How much is my first appointment at Aspen Dental going to cost? add_circle_outline
We believe that everyone deserves a healthy smile. So, our  dental care services  are not only thorough, but also affordable and accessible to you. Once you receive your personalized treatment plan, your Aspen Dental care team can help you make sure you get the care you need. We partner with 3rd-party financing options that offer flexible ways to pay and manage treatment costs. In addition, the Aspen Dental Savings Plan ¹ provides discounts on eligible dental services for patients without dental insurance.
¹The Aspen Dental Savings Plan is NOT insurance. Please see plan terms and conditions for details.
Billing & payments FAQs
Can I pay my Aspen Dental bill online or over the phone? add_circle_outline
Yes, use our secure Aspen Dental patient billing portal to view your balance, make payments and update billing information. You can also pay by phone by calling your local Aspen Dental office or email customerservice@aspendental.com  for assistance.
What is the Aspen Dental billing phone number? add_circle_outline
For any billing or payment questions, call (833) 902-4848 or  email customerservice@aspendental.com .
How do I update or change my billing information? add_circle_outline
You can update billing details like your address or payment method through the Aspen Dental patient services login. If you run into any issues, email customerservice@aspendental.com and we'll assist you.
Why was my payment method declined? add_circle_outline
Payment methods may be declined due to incorrect information, insufficient funds or technical issues. Check with your bank or card provider, then email  customerservice@aspendental.com  to verify or update your payment details.
My payment isn’t showing on my account – what should I do? add_circle_outline
Payments typically process within 1-2 business days. If your payment hasn't appeared after this timeframe, email  customerservice@aspendental.com  with your payment confirmation details. We'll help verify your payment and update your account immediately.
